_readme: Learned rules for the automatic vendor-variance sweep (src/lib/varianceSweep.ts). Built from graded flags in the Variance Review panel. aliases: {actual_pattern, budget_target, bucket|null, source}. expected_variances / suppressions: {trip_pattern, line_pattern, note, source} (regex, case-insensitive). pinned_links: actual trip id -> historical_trips id prefix. thresholds: flag when |delta| >= pct of budget AND >= abs.

expected_variances.note: Client bought an extra Hypoxico that wasn't budgeted; the extra cost is offset by extra revenue (Drew, R1-03).

suppressions.note: Contingency is a misc buffer for unexpected expenses; nothing in actuals against it is fine (Drew, R1-16/R1-17, 2026-08-07)
